class.name: ResourceImporterCubeLUT
class.brief_description: Imports a [code].cube[/code] look-up table as a [CompressedTexture3D].
class.description: Imports Adobe/Resolve [code].cube[/code] LUT files, the format cameras, grading tools and LUT packs ship, for [member CameraAttributes.lut_texture] and [member Environment.adjustment_color_correction]. 3D tables, 1D tables, and a 1D shaper followed by a 3D table are supported, with [code]DOMAIN_MIN[/code]/[code]DOMAIN_MAX[/code] and Resolve's [code]LUT_1D_INPUT_RANGE[/code]/[code]LUT_3D_INPUT_RANGE[/code]. A 3D table over the default [code]0.0[/code]-[code]1.0[/code] domain is kept exactly; anything else is evaluated over a 3D grid on that domain (at least 33 entries per side, 65 for a 1D table), with input outside a table's domain clamped to its edge. The texture stores uncompressed half floats, so outputs outside [code]0.0[/code]-[code]1.0[/code] are kept.
